name: comparison-table
title: Comparison table
description: Comparison table with a highlighted Context.dev column and text or check-mark cells.
usage: Comparing the product with an alternative: `text` on a use-case page (your own crawler against the API), `marks` for an alternatives page's full feature comparison. Mark Context.dev's column with `highlight`.
avoid: Red crosses for a missing feature (an en dash)
notes: The card scrolls sideways on narrow screens and is focusable, so a keyboard can scroll it too; `caption` names it.

reference.scope: Tokenized, framework-independent adaptation. Public measurements cover shared styles; retained variants are not a claim of current public-page parity.
